import re
src = open('syntax.py').read()
old_start = src.index("# One pass of the tokenizer")
old_end = src.index("class PolicyError")
new = '''# One tokenizer pass yields a whitespace run, a name, punctuation, or any
# other single code point (which is a forbidden character for policy syntax).
_TOKEN = re.compile(
    '([ \\t\\f\\r\\n]+)'
    '|([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,23})'
    '|([();,])'
    '|([\\s\\S])'
)


'''
src = src[:old_start] + new + src[old_end:]
old_fn = src[src.index('def _tokens(text):'):src.index('class _Reader')]
new_fn = '''def _tokens(text):
    for matched in _TOKEN.finditer(text):
        name = matched.group(2)
        if name is not None:
            yield name
            continue
        punct = matched.group(3)
        if punct is not None:
            yield punct
            continue
        if matched.group(1) is not None:
            # Declared whitespace between tokens is ignored.
            continue
        # Vertical tab and every other Unicode code point that is not a
        # declared token character rejects the stage.
        raise PolicyError('forbidden character')


'''
src = src.replace(old_fn, new_fn)
open('syntax.py','w').write(src)
